svg.title: Indochina interlock network
svg.text: 29 firms in 13 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 548 firms, 6,243 interlocks, 14 components (largest 519). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 119 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
